name: phi-spaces-codemode-chat
description: Next.js 16 + React 19 codemode chat: agents and people contribute code to a phi-space, judged in a codemode sandbox

scripts.docker:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm --build codemode-chat-test
scripts.docker:prod:up: echo 'one host runs one profile: docker:nano:up on nano, docker:big:up on big, docker:local:up for both on this machine' && exit 1
scripts.docker:prod:down: echo 'use docker:nano:down on nano, docker:big:down on big, docker:local:down locally' && exit 1
scripts.docker:prod:logs: echo 'use docker:nano:logs on nano, docker:big:logs on big, docker:local:logs locally' && exit 1
scripts.docker:image: docker build --network host -f docker/Dockerfile --target production -t phi-spaces-codemode:prod ..
scripts.docker:nano:up: npm run docker:image && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:big:up: npm run docker:image && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:big:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big down
scripts.docker:big:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:local:up: NANO_CPUS=${NANO_CPUS:-2} PORT=${PORT:-3710} CODEMODE_SPACE_BIND=127.0.0.1 CODEMODE_SPACE_PORT=3810 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-codemode-local --profile nano --profile big up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:local:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-codemode-local --profile nano --profile big down
scripts.docker:local:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-codemode-local --profile nano --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:backup: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano exec space node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types server/backup.ts
scripts.docker:local:backup: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-codemode-local --profile nano exec space node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types server/backup.ts
scripts.docker:dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev up -d --build codemode-chat-dev
scripts.docker:dev:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev logs -f codemode-chat-dev
